## What this changes

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read the scope section of [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and this adds no
      tooling, malware, recovery procedures or operational material
- [ ] I edited `pages.py`, not the generated HTML
- [ ] `python3 engine.py` and `python3 make_structure.py` were run, and the result is committed
- [ ] `python3 -m unittest discover tests` passes
- [ ] Any new simulation uses real Web Crypto, with a key that is fixed and visible
- [ ] Any new diagram is SVG with a caption and an accessible label
